title: Step 59-C Home authoritative data loader foundation
description: Implement the server-only Home data boundary for the existing GET /products contract. Preserve the customer session cookie bridge so backend-authoritative retail/wholesale price context can flow without browser token authority; classify safe GET failures through the existing AsyncSurfaceState/recovery foundation; propagate validated Set-Cookie values; wire the Home route loader without implementing Home merchandising or Step-60 search/category listing behavior. Because the current OpenAPI responses for /categories and /brands have no typed JSON content, do not invent category/brand payloads or models in this Stage.

dependencies.name: Header, responsive navigation and search entry

acceptance_criteria.description: Home server data uses the generated OpenAPI type for GET /products and does not define a parallel authoritative ProductCard/price/inventory DTO.

Home product loading uses the existing customer session cookie bridge, strips unrelated/admin/browser authorization authority, captures only validated customer Set-Cookie values, and never exposes credentials to client code.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront home-data:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront auth:verify

acceptance_criteria.description: GET failures are mapped through the existing AsyncSurfaceState/recovery policy; empty product responses become first-use empty state; no automatic mutation retry, new polling, raw backend error message, or client-side business authority is introduced.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront home-data:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront state:verify

acceptance_criteria.description: The Home route owns a server loader and consumes loader data while preserving one-H1/SSR quality. This Stage does not render product merchandising, category/brand discovery, search results, filters, sorting, pagination, product detail, cart or checkout behavior.
No category/brand response model is invented while /categories and /brands remain content-less in the generated OpenAPI contract; no backend/API/contract/database/dependency/lockfile change occurs.

Full root pnpm verify, exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Browser Quality, deterministic review, active exact-artifact lock, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification pass before Stage 59-D starts.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 59-C is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 59-D remains blocked until protected transport and exact-SHA postmerge verification are green.
